hooks.command: set -a; source "$CLAUDEDIR/.env"; if command -v security &>/dev/null; then export SYNAPSE_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -a "synapse-worker-${SYNAPSE_WORKER_ID}" -s "synapse" -w 2>/dev/null || echo "${SYNAPSE_API_KEY:-}"); elif command -v secret-tool &>/dev/null; then export SYNAPSE_API_KEY=$(secret-tool lookup account "synapse-worker-${SYNAPSE_WORKER_ID}" service "synapse" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SYNAPSE_API_KEY:-}"); fi; set +a
